project.name: LTEngine
project.description: A free, open-source, self-hosted Local AI Machine Translation API written in Rust. It exposes a LibreTranslate-compatible REST API whose translations are produced by large language models (Gemma3 GGUF) running locally via llama.cpp, with automatic source-language detection and a bundled web UI.

nodes.name: Translation API
nodes.summary: The LibreTranslate-compatible HTTP API that accepts translation and language-detection requests, validates them, and returns translated text. It is the primary product surface, parsing JSON/form/multipart payloads and orchestrating language detection, prompt building, and LLM inference.

businessRules: Requests exceeding the configured char_limit (default 5000) are rejected with 400
If an API key is configured, requests must supply a matching api_key or receive 403
Only 'text' and 'html' formats are accepted
When source == target the input is echoed back without invoking the LLM
Output punctuation and casing are normalized to match the input via improve_formatting
crossDomainInteractions: Delegates source-language detection to Language Services
Invokes LLM Translation to generate translated text
Reports the language catalog from Language Services via /languages

nodes.name: Language Services
nodes.summary: Maintains the catalog of ~48 supported languages with their codes, display names, and translation targets, and performs automatic source-language detection. Detection is constrained to the supported allowlist using the whatlang library.

businessRules: Detection is restricted to the allowlist of supported languages
External-facing codes (e.g. zh-Hans, pt-BR) are mapped to internal codes
Confidence is reported as an integer percentage (0-100)
If detection fails the first catalog entry (English) is returned with confidence 0
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies detected language and confidence to the /detect and /translate endpoints
Resolves source/target language display names used by Prompt building in LLM Translation

nodes.name: LLM Translation Generation
nodes.summary: Builds the system/user prompt for the translation task and runs it through a locally hosted Gemma3 model via llama.cpp. Handles tokenization, context creation, batched decoding, and sampling to produce the translated string, serializing inference behind a mutex.

businessRules: System prompt instructs the model to return only the translation with no explanation
HTML format prompt additionally requires preserving all HTML tags
Context size is allocated as 3x the prompt token count
Inference is serialized via a prompt_lock mutex because the bindings are not thread-safe
GPU layers are offloaded when CUDA/Vulkan features are enabled and --cpu is not set
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes resolved language names from Language Services to build prompts
Returns generated text to the Translation API
Requires a loaded model from Model Management at startup

nodes.name: Model Management
nodes.summary: Resolves which GGUF model to use and makes it available on disk, either by validating a user-supplied local .gguf file or by downloading a registered Gemma3 model from HuggingFace. Runs once during server startup before the LLM is initialized.

businessRules: A local model path must exist and have a .gguf extension or loading fails
Remote models are resolved from the gemma3 registry (1b/4b/12b/27b) and downloaded from HuggingFace
A non-empty --model-file overrides the registry selection and forces local loading
Failure to load the model terminates the process at startup
crossDomainInteractions: Provides the resolved model path to LLM Translation at startup
Triggered by the server bootstrap in the Translation API process

nodes.name: Web Translation UI
nodes.summary: The bundled Vue 2 single-page frontend that lets users type text, pick source/target languages, and see live translations. It loads frontend settings and the language list on startup and debounces translation requests to the API.

businessRules: Translation requests are debounced by frontendTimeout before being sent
HTML format is auto-selected when the input matches an HTML tag regex
Detected language and confidence are displayed when source is 'auto'
Source/target/query are persisted to URL query params for shareable links
File translation and suggestions are present in the UI but disabled by backend settings
crossDomainInteractions: Calls the Translation API endpoints /frontend/settings, /languages and /translate
Served as static resources by the Translation API server

nodes.name: Translate Text
nodes.summary: Handles a translation request end to end: parses the payload, validates parameters, resolves languages, builds the prompt, runs LLM inference, and returns formatted translated text.

nodes.name: Detect Language
nodes.summary: Detects the language of submitted text and returns the language code with a confidence score.

nodes.name: List Supported Languages
nodes.summary: Returns the full catalog of supported languages with codes, names, and valid translation targets.

nodes.name: Serve Frontend Settings
nodes.summary: Returns UI configuration (char limit, default languages, feature flags) consumed by the web frontend at startup.

nodes.name: Server Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Application startup: parses CLI args, loads the model, initializes the LLM, registers HTTP routes and static files, then binds and runs the actix-web server.

nodes.name: Auto-Detect Source Language
nodes.summary: Detects the source language of input text using whatlang constrained to the supported allowlist, returning the matched Language and confidence.

nodes.name: Generate Translation via LLM
nodes.summary: Runs the translation prompt through the local Gemma3 model: applies the chat template, tokenizes, creates a context, then decodes and samples tokens until end-of-generation.

nodes.name: Resolve and Load Model
nodes.summary: Determines whether to use a local .gguf file or a registered HuggingFace model, validates or downloads it, and returns the on-disk path.

nodes.name: UI Live Translate
nodes.summary: Frontend flow that captures user input, debounces it, posts to /translate, renders the result, and shows the detected language when source is auto.

nodes.name: UI Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Frontend initialization that loads /frontend/settings and /languages, then applies source/target/query URL parameters to prefill the UI.

nodes.name: Parse Payload
nodes.summary: Parses the request body as JSON, urlencoded form, or multipart into a TranslateRequest based on content-type.

nodes.name: Validate Parameters
nodes.summary: Ensures q, source and target are present, enforces the API key, and rejects text over the char limit.

nodes.name: Check Format
nodes.summary: Validates that the requested format is 'text' or 'html'.

nodes.name: Resolve Languages
nodes.summary: Resolves source and target language codes to display names (or 'auto'), erroring on unsupported codes.

nodes.name: Build Prompt
nodes.summary: Uses PromptBuilder to construct the system/user prompt for the resolved languages and format.

nodes.name: Run Inference
nodes.summary: Calls LLM.run_prompt to generate the translation, echoing input when source equals target.

nodes.name: Improve Formatting
nodes.summary: Normalizes trailing punctuation and casing of the translation to match the input text.

nodes.name: Attach Detected Language
nodes.summary: When source is 'auto', detects the input language and adds detectedLanguage to the response.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.summary: Returns the JSON response with translatedText and optional alternatives/detectedLanguage.

nodes.name: Parse Payload
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the request, requiring the q parameter.

nodes.name: Detect Language
nodes.summary: Runs detect_lang on the text to obtain language code and confidence.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.summary: Returns a JSON array with the detected language code and confidence.

nodes.name: Serialize Catalog
nodes.summary: Serializes the LANGUAGES catalog as JSON.

nodes.name: Build Settings
nodes.summary: Builds and returns the frontend settings JSON including char limit and default languages.

nodes.name: Parse CLI Args
nodes.summary: Parses host, port, model, char limit, API key and acceleration flags with clap.

nodes.name: Load Model
nodes.summary: Resolves and loads the model file, exiting on failure.

nodes.name: Initialize LLM
nodes.summary: Creates the shared LLM instance from the loaded model, exiting on failure.

nodes.name: Register Routes
nodes.summary: Registers all HTTP services and static resource files on the actix-web App.

nodes.name: Bind and Run
nodes.summary: Binds the server to host:port and runs the event loop.

nodes.name: Build Allowlist
nodes.summary: Builds the whatlang allowlist from the supported language catalog.

nodes.name: Run Detector
nodes.summary: Runs the whatlang Detector over the input text to obtain language and confidence.

nodes.name: Map to Language
nodes.summary: Maps the detected whatlang Lang back to a catalog Language, defaulting to English on failure.

nodes.name: Apply Chat Template
nodes.summary: Applies the model's chat template to the system and user messages.

nodes.name: Tokenize
nodes.summary: Converts the templated prompt string into tokens with a BOS marker.

nodes.name: Create Context
nodes.summary: Creates a llama context sized to 3x the prompt tokens, locking the prompt mutex.

nodes.name: Decode and Sample
nodes.summary: Decodes the batch and samples tokens with a chained sampler (dry, top-k, top-p, etc.) until end-of-generation.

nodes.name: Collect Output
nodes.summary: Accumulates decoded token pieces into the final translated string.

nodes.name: Select Source
nodes.summary: Chooses a Local model from --model-file or a Remote model from the registry.

nodes.name: Validate Local File
nodes.summary: Validates that the local path exists and has a .gguf extension.

nodes.name: Download Remote Model
nodes.summary: Downloads the registered GGUF model from HuggingFace with progress.

nodes.name: Capture Input
nodes.summary: Captures input text and language selections, updating URL query params.

nodes.name: Debounce Request
nodes.summary: Debounces translation by frontendTimeout and aborts any in-flight request.

nodes.name: POST /translate
nodes.summary: Sends the input, languages, format and API key as multipart form data to /translate.

nodes.name: Render Result
nodes.summary: Parses the response and updates translatedText and the raw output display.

nodes.name: Show Detected Language
nodes.summary: When source is auto, displays the detected language name and confidence.

nodes.name: Load Settings
nodes.summary: Requests /frontend/settings and applies char limit, default languages and feature flags.

nodes.name: Load Languages
nodes.summary: Requests /languages, normalizes names and appends the Auto Detect option.

nodes.name: Apply Query Params
nodes.summary: Reads source/target/q URL params to prefill the UI and trigger an initial translation.

edges.description: The /translate and /detect endpoints call detect_lang and resolve language codes to names via Language Services
The /translate endpoint builds a Prompt and calls LLM.run_prompt to generate the translation
PromptBuilder uses resolved source/target language display names from the language catalog
load_model resolves the GGUF path consumed by LLM::new during server bootstrap
The Vue frontend calls /frontend/settings, /languages and /translate over HTTP
